body: Thanks for connecting, Dana. Northwind Pay's Backend Engineer, Payments post asks for recurring card mandates. At Tidewater Freight I led the mandate retry service, and failed mandate payments fell from 3% to 1% in its first year. I applied on 20 September. Are you the right person to ask about next steps? If not, a name is plenty.

R1.text: Northwind Pay job post, Backend Engineer, Payments, posted 2026-09-12. Meet the hiring team: Dana Cruz, Talent Partner. Requirements: recurring card mandates, Go, Postgres.
R1.snippet: Meet the hiring team: Dana Cruz, Talent Partner. Requirements: recurring card mandates, Go, Postgres.

profile_facts.P1: 4 years building Go payment services at Tidewater Freight.
profile_facts.P2: Led the mandate retry service at Tidewater Freight, about 1 million requests per day; failed mandate payments fell from 3% to 1% in its first year.
profile_facts.P4: Applied to Northwind Pay Backend Engineer, Payments on 20 September 2026.
profile_facts.P5: At Tidewater Freight, fixed a retry storm behind a slow partner bank in 2025 with per-bank retry budgets; duplicate charge complaints fell from about 30 a week to 3.
